description: This source file is a shell script for testing git merge-base performance. It defines functions to build complex commit histories with multiple merges, creates branches, performs garbage collection, and runs tests to verify the correctness of merge-base computations and other git commands.

methods.name: build_history
methods.description: Creates a commit history with a binary tree structure of merges up to a specified level, generating commits with marks and messages.

methods.name: build_history2
methods.description: Creates a similar commit history as build_history but with a different merging pattern, reusing root commits, resulting in multiple merge bases between top commits.
